en-GB.name: Device Finder
en-GB.summary: Privately rings your linked Apple devices using Apple Find My.
en-GB.description: A private beta skill that asks Apple Find My to play a sound on the linked user's own Apple devices.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask Device Finder to ring my phone
Alexa, ask Device Finder where my iPad is
